description: Free time (days) before demurrage, detention or storage charges start, for a carrier at a port or country. Returns the carrier's OWN published figure when available, otherwise an INDICATIVE cross-carrier average (flagged is_estimate, shown without prejudice). Use for 'how many free days does <carrier> give at <port>'.

carrier_code.description: SCAC, e.g. CMDU (CMA CGM), MAEU (Maersk), HLCU (Hapag), ZIMU (ZIM). Omit to get the indicative cross-carrier average directly.

country_iso2.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2, e.g. FR. Used when no port is given, or as fallback grain.

port_unlocode.description: 5-char UN/LOCODE, e.g. FRMRS (Marseille). Provide this or country_iso2.

name: get_demurrage_free_time

code.description: On an empty result: NOT_FOUND (no record after asking) or NO_EVENTS (record, nothing filed).

is_estimate.description: True means this is an indicative cross-carrier average, not the line's own figure

message.description: On an empty result: what the emptiness means.

ok.description: False never appears here — failures arrive as tool errors.

result.description: "empty" means the query succeeded and there is nothing to report.
